title: Chapter 18 Revision — Work & Study
description: Mixed revision quiz covering verbal nouns (-nie/-cie), noun derivation (-ość), compound sentences, and work/study vocabulary from Chapter 18.

questions.prompt: Form the verbal noun from 'pisać' (to write). Lubię ___.
questions.explanation: pisać → pisanie (writing). Infinitive → drop -ć → add -nie. 'Lubię pisanie' = I like writing. The verbal noun is neuter and used in acc. after lubić.

questions.prompt: ___ języków obcych jest trudne. (Learning foreign languages is difficult.) [verbal noun]
questions.explanation: uczyć się → uczenie się (learning). Verbal noun as sentence subject. 'Uczenie się języków obcych jest trudne' = Learning foreign languages is difficult.

questions.prompt: Verbal noun from 'żyć' (to live). ___ w Krakowie jest wspaniałe.
questions.explanation: żyć → życie (life/living). Irregular verbal noun. 'Życie w Krakowie jest wspaniałe' = Life/Living in Kraków is wonderful. Neuter → wspaniałe.

questions.prompt: Dziękuję za ___. (Thank you for your understanding.)
questions.explanation: 'Zrozumienie' = understanding (verbal noun from perfective zrozumieć). 'Za + accusative': za zrozumienie. A fixed polite phrase: 'Dziękuję za zrozumienie.'
wolny → wolność (f) = freedom. The -ość suffix creates abstract nouns from adjectives. 'Wolność jest ważna' = Freedom is important. Feminine → 'ważna'.
'Możliwość' (f) = possibility / opportunity. From 'możliwy' + -ość. Very common: 'Mam możliwość pracy zdalnej' = I have the opportunity to work remotely.

questions.prompt: Chcę iść, ___ jestem zmęczony. (I want to go, but I'm tired.)
questions.explanation: 'Ale' = but (adversarial). Contrasts 'wanting to go' with 'being tired'. 'I' = and (addition). 'Więc' = so/therefore. 'Bo' = because (causal).

questions.prompt: Uczę się, ___ zdać egzamin. (I study in order to pass the exam.) [purpose]
questions.explanation: 'Żeby + infinitive' = in order to (purpose, same subject). 'Uczę się, żeby zdać egzamin.' 'Że' introduces a statement (that). 'Bo' = because (reason, not purpose).

questions.prompt: Ona czyta książki, ___ ja słucham muzyki. (She reads books, and I listen to music.) [parallel contrast]
questions.explanation: 'A' expresses parallel contrast — two different people doing two different things. 'Ale' = adversarial but. 'I' = simple and. This 'a' pattern is very typical in Polish.
'Rozmowa kwalifikacyjna' = job interview. 'Rozmowa' = conversation/talk; 'kwalifikacyjna' = qualifying/qualification. Essential work vocabulary.

questions.prompt: How do you say 'to pass an exam' in Polish?
questions.explanation: 'Zdać egzamin' (perf) = to pass an exam. 'Oblać egzamin' = to fail an exam. 'Zdać' literally means to hand over/deliver — one of many Polish phrasal meanings.

questions.prompt: Zostałam w domu, ___ byłam chora. (I stayed at home because I was sick.)
questions.explanation: 'Bo' = because (informal causal conjunction). 'Ponieważ' would also be correct (formal). 'Ale' = but. 'Żeby' = in order to. 'Chociaż' = although (would give the opposite meaning).
